description: Computes Australian resident income tax (2025-26 ATO brackets) plus Medicare levy, Medicare levy surcharge, LITO offset, and HELP/HECS repayment. Example: { taxableIncome: 95000, privateHospitalCover: true, hasHelpDebt: false }. Estimate for guidance — 2026 rates from official sources (IRS/Tax Foundation/CRA/ATO/state revenue offices/HMRC).

hasHelpDebt.description: True if the taxpayer has an outstanding HELP/HECS debt (triggers compulsory repayment).

privateHospitalCover.description: True if covered by private hospital insurance (avoids the Medicare Levy Surcharge).

name: au_income_tax
title: Australia resident income tax
